Definition
[Rotationally symmetric $S^3$ metric (Equation 36.1)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0331 1. ch36:36.1-metric\group Numerical Simulation

A rotationally symmetric metric on $S^3$ is written \[ g=e^{2X}\bigl(e^{-2W}\, d\psi ^2+e^{2W}\sin ^2\psi \, [d\theta ^2+ \sin ^2\theta \, d\phi ^2]\bigr), \] where $X,W$ depend only on $\psi $. Smoothness at the poles requires $S:=W/\sin ^2\psi $ to have finite limits there.
